subject: Quick thought on Florida City Dental's website and new patient flow
body:
Hi Florida City Dental team,

I’ve been following your 14 years of community service here in Homestead, and I really admire how welcoming you make your practice for patients looking for cosmetic makeovers or major restorations like All-on-X implants. 

While browsing your current site, I noticed that the mobile user experience could be streamlined by making phone numbers instantly clickable across all viewports and ensuring the $65 new patient special and operating hours stand out right near the primary contact buttons.

To see how these minor tweaks could elevate your patient booking flow, I went ahead and built a clean, modern live prototype for you here: https://nayom-biz-0x88d9e74657f8b06f-0xd765b3844973d1b-5b852glrf.vercel.app

Feel free to check out the live preview. If you'd like to use this design or have me make a few adjustments, I'd be happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you're completely happy with your current setup!
business_name: Florida City Dental - General Dentistry & Cosmetic Smile Design!
key_improvements: Added mobile-friendly click-to-call phone number links across all viewports
Highlighted operating hours prominently near primary contact buttons
Streamlined layout for the $65 New Patient Special and All-on-X implants
